## My request:
시각 의미 데이터와 후보팩에 반영해줘. 그 다음 독립된 서브에이전트 3개에서 각각 서로 다른 컨셉으로 반영한 키워드가 이미지에 실제로 반영되는지까지 테스트할 수 있는 랜덤한 복잡한 컨셉을 정하여 테스트케이스를 마련하고 첨부한 이미지를 활용하여 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘.
interpreted_intent: Independently randomized complex reference-based beauty editorial test of implemented visual keyword data. All staging choices are agent-owned, not user definitions.
subject: one adult woman with visible facial and hair appearance from supplied portrait
event: woman rests both forearms and relaxed hands on a waist-high stone counter and looks at camera
visual_priorities: visible copper eyelid makeup and plum lips on face with real skin texture
long dark broad hair waves and plausible resting hand contact
baseline_prompt_en: Create a photographic beauty editorial of one adult woman in a rain-streaked rooftop studio at dusk, using the attached portrait as the appearance reference. Preserve the visible reference features: long dark center-parted wavy hair, brown eyes, oval face, softly arched brows, a slender straight nose, and the natural shape of her lips. Her face, makeup, skin, and hair are the visual center of the photograph. Copper metallic pigment covers both upper eyelids in a smooth reflective sweep, while a precise plum stain defines the lips. Real skin retains fine pores and soft tonal variation beneath the luminous makeup. Her hair falls in distinct broad waves over both shoulders, with individual strands visible at the edges. She stands behind a waist-high stone counter, both forearms resting parallel on its top; her relaxed hands lie separately on the stone with fingers softly curved, wrists connected naturally to the forearms. Her upright torso supports a slight forward lean toward the camera. She looks directly into the lens with a calm, poised expression. A black open-collar blouse frames the neck. A large diffused overhead light reveals the eyelid shimmer and cheek texture, while a pink background glow illuminates the rain-streaked windows behind her. Frame a vertical waist-up portrait with the entire face, both hair silhouettes, and both resting hands visible; the counter crosses the lower foreground. Keep the background softly out of focus while the eyes and copper eyelids remain crisp.
